title: NOT IN where the outer column is nullable and the list is never NULL
prompt: Promotions audit, run each morning for the last quarter (about 1.1M orders). Runtime about 95 s. Plan: Nested Loops
(Left Anti Semi Join) with a Row Count Spool, because Orders.PromoCode is nullable. BlockedPromoCodes.PromoCode is
the primary key, so the list never holds a NULL. Today the report returns about 160k rows: orders with a promo code
that is not blocked. Orders without a promo code (85% of all orders) are not in the report, and finance reads the row
count as 'orders with a valid promo code'. The list is reloaded nightly by truncate and insert, and the audit has run
data_notes: Azure SQL Database, General Purpose Gen5, 8 vCores, compatibility level 160. READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON. Query Store READ_WRITE. Collation SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS. All foreign keys are trusted. Statistics: auto create and auto update ON; a nightly job updates Orders, OrderLines and Payments with FULLSCAN.

Orders: 30M rows, 2016 to now, ~12k per day now. The 25 partner customers own ~9M orders (30%), up to 1.2M each. Other customers average ~10 orders (max ~400). The density estimate for CustomerID is ~15 rows. Status: Shipped 83.8%, Cancelled 7%, Paid 6%, Returned 3%, Pending 0.2% (~60k rows, all from the last 72 hours). SalesChannel: Web 62%, Store 20%, Partner 12%, Phone 6%. PromoCode is NULL for 85%. ShipRegionID is NULL for Store pickups (~20%). OrderDate is datetime2(7); Partner and Store imports stamp one timestamp on a whole batch, so many orders of one customer share an OrderDate.
BlockedPromoCodes: 40k rows. PromoCode is the primary key (NOT NULL). The list is reloaded nightly by truncate and insert.
baseline_sql: AND o.PromoCode NOT IN (SELECT b.PromoCode FROM qe.BlockedPromoCodes b);

correct_families.description: NOT EXISTS for the match, plus the outer NULL rule of NOT IN: an order with no promo code is returned only when the list is empty.

all: o\.PromoCode is not null\s+or\s+not exists|not exists\s*\([^)]*\)\s*or\s+o\.PromoCode is not null

reference_sql: AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qe.BlockedPromoCodes b WHERE b.PromoCode = o.PromoCode)
AND (o.PromoCode IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qe.BlockedPromoCodes b));

traps.why: NOT EXISTS keeps an order whose PromoCode is NULL; NOT IN rejects it. The report grows from about 160k rows to more than a million.
traps.told_apart_by: Today's data: every order of the quarter that has no promo code.
example_sql: AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qe.BlockedPromoCodes b WHERE b.PromoCode = o.PromoCode);

traps.why: PromoCode IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (match) differs from NOT IN while the list is empty: NOT IN then returns the orders without a promo code as well.
traps.told_apart_by: BlockedPromoCodes empty, as it is during the nightly reload.
example_sql: AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qe.BlockedPromoCodes b WHERE b.PromoCode = o.PromoCode);

traps.why: LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL keeps the orders without a promo code, like plain NOT EXISTS.
traps.told_apart_by: Today's data: every order of the quarter that has no promo code.
example_sql: LEFT JOIN qe.BlockedPromoCodes b ON b.PromoCode = o.PromoCode

min_improvement.basis: The spool-based anti join (95 s) becomes one hash or merge anti join over 1.1M orders and 40k codes.

key.reference_notes: The inner column is a primary key, so the 'NULL in the list' rule of NOT IN cannot apply: that part of the proof is backed by a constraint. Tell the owner that the report changes meaning while the list is empty.
